title: The vacuous and duplicate tests go and the CLI tests stop writing to the home directory
body: Batch 4 of sufr-25f57e. Delete long_dna_is_sorted, masked_long_dna_is_sorted, uniprot_is_sorted and masked_uniprot_is_sorted once batch 1 lands. Delete extract_uniprot_masked_low_memory, identical to extract_uniprot_masked. create_empty_dies runs on data/inputs/empty.fa (sufr-56f73a). The summarize helper fails on a row its regex does not match (sufr-f9b051). The five -m CLI tests set HOME to a temp dir through assert_cmd's env so the locate cache stays out of ~/.sufr.
